victory.primary: Kill the Dragon by reducing Health to 0.
victory.no-dragon: If no Dragon: smash 5 Crystal tokens, then escape the Cave by entering the Entrance tile.

setup.hero-cubes: 2 near board (on “0” Grit); remaining on Grit track spaces 5, 11, 18, 26, 35

turn-summary.note: Turn ends when phases complete. May end without completing both. Before ending, may assign unused Hero cubes to stats or equipment/Treasure not requiring Encounters.

statistics.stat: Distance in tiles you can move per turn.
Encounters per turn; affects Thief interaction.
Certain attacks; defense outside your turn.
statistics.rule: Each turn statistics start at 1 (leftmost track space).

phase.title: Pick Up Hero Cubes
phase.rule: Pick up all Hero cubes on board except those on Grit track and discarded. First turn: pick up the two cubes set near board.

hero-cubes.rule: Any time on turn, allocate Hero cubes to increase Movement/Perception/Strength, equipment (Bomb, Bow, Ancient Map, Shield), Treasure cards.
Allocating to statistic track: increases to number shown; place left to right from leftmost empty (second space onward).
Allocating to equipment/Treasure: enables effect. Cube stays until next Pick Up phase. If discard Hero cube → Discarded space. Recover via Cave Bread Event.
Starting two Hero cubes can never be lost or discarded.

phase.title: Move and Act
phase.rule: Move adjacent tiles up to Movement; spend Encounters up to Perception. Move and spend in any order; can only move while Encounters remain.
Normally cannot move through walls; Ancient Map: each use moves through one wall.

By spending one Encounter, actions in order: (1) Reveal and Resolve Dark Tile — required if applicable; (2) Resolve Attacks — Crystals, Dragon, Goblins, Thief, any order; (3) Collect Treasures — Dragon Gems, Treasure tokens.
One Encounter can cover any or all of these on a Lit tile (e.g. one Encounter to attack Dragon and pick up two Treasures).
Attacks/collections must be on your tile.
Move onto Dark tile: must spend Encounter to reveal and resolve, then may do other actions.

revealing-tiles.rule: Enter Dark tile: reveal (flip Lit), place, resolve. After resolve: gain 1 Grit.
revealing-tiles.clarification: Event and Ambush effects from the revealed tile resolve before the Knight gains the 1 Grit and any Hero cube that Grit might unlock.
revealing-tiles.rule: Place revealed tile connecting to tile moved from; if entered through open side, place open side of revealed tile against source. Cave adds Dark tiles on open sides (or you draw if no Cave).
revealing-tiles.tile-type: Cave plays Event card on you (or you draw if no Cave). Enter or start turn on tile with Event token: resolve as Event tile, remove token.
May assign more Hero cubes to Strength immediately. Goblins may attack with hidden Tribe if Tribe Strength > your Strength. If attack: lose 1 Health, Tribe scatters, Goblins Rage −1.
Place Treasure token; may pick up as part of Encounter or ignore.
Place Crystal token; may smash as part of Encounter or ignore.

dragon.rule: Underground: enter Dragon tile without Encounter if not attacking. Attacking costs Encounter.
Surface: to enter, Strength ≥ Dragon Armor, then must attack (as Encounter).

attacking.rule: Underground, before Collapse: only with Bomb equipment; once per turn.
After Collapse begins: can attack without Bomb; still once per turn while underground.
Surface: no Bomb required; multiple attacks per turn, each separate Encounter, without moving.

resolution.if: Roll Dragon die; succeeds only if die affects center tile.

attacking.rule: Dragon Health 0: Dragon dies; Knight wins.

goblins.rule: Enter tile with revealed Tribe only if Strength > Tribe Strength; then must attack (Encounter); Tribe scatters. Multiple Tribes: attack all in same Encounter.

thief.rule: Enter Thief tile without Encounter if not attacking.
To attack Thief: Perception > Thief Stealth. Success: Thief killed; gain Grit equal to his Loot Drop Level.

smashing-crystals.rule: If Strength ≥ 3, may smash Crystal on your tile. Place on Smashed Crystals; gain 2 Grit.
smashing-crystals.no-dragon: Win: smash 5 Crystals then escape Cave (Entrance).

treasures.name: Treasure effects (on collect)
treasures.item: Shoot Dragon or Thief up to 5 tiles straight line, even Dragon underground or Dark/open spaces between. Before/during/after movement. No Encounter. Dragon discards Power cards = Strength − 1, max 3. Thief is killed only if Knight Perception > Thief Stealth.

Next attack gains +1 Strength and may target the underground Dragon without Bomb or a visible player piece up to 3 spaces away. Cannot use Javelin same turn as Bomb underground attack. No Hero cube; costs Encounter to attack. Remove from game after use.
+1 Strength during turn. If attack Dragon succeeds and cube on Axe, may discard cube for extra −1 Health (2 total). Cannot use with Bomb underground.
Remove from game + discard activating Hero cube → regain 2 Health.

clarifications.treasures: When multiple Treasure or Dragon Gem tokens are on the Knight's tile, one Encounter can collect them all, but each token resolves separately, one at a time.
clarifications.javelin: Throwing Javelin follows attack rules at range, so Sidequests, Rage, Unnatural Evasion, and other attack-triggered effects apply.
clarifications.enchanted-bow: Enchanted Bow is not an attack for attack-triggered effects, even when it kills the Thief or forces Dragon discards.

equipment.item: Move through walls; two touching tile edges with walls = one wall. Each cube = one wall. Does not change Movement costs.

Attack Dragon (Encounter) underground before Collapse; OR place Bomb token to permanently remove wall. Bomb not needed to attack surfaced Dragon or after Collapse. Attacking with Bomb does not consume token. Rotate/Rockslide on Bomb edge removes Bomb from game.
Shoot visible Goblin Tribe at unlimited range; Population − (Strength − 1); does not scatter Tribe. Before/during/after movement; no Encounter.
Ignore effects that would move you. Each Grit loss reduced to 1 if Shield activated before effects revealed.

dragon-gem-collect.rule: Roll Dragon die. If affects center: −2 Grit (trap). Else: +5 Grit. Return Gem to Dragon.

treasure-token-collect.rule: Cave draws 2 Treasure cards, gives one; other to bottom (or draw top if no Cave).
May keep facedown or decline for 5 Grit (remove card).
Empty Treasure deck: gain 5 Grit each time.

sidequests.rule: Reveal from hand if requirements met; remove from game; gain Grit (upper-right); draw replacement.
“Attack” for Sidequest: attack you prompt on your turn; not Bow or Ambush tile reveal.

grit.intro: Track on Grit track. Reach space with Hero cube → take cube (usable same turn). Fall below white space → return cube to that space; if must return placed cube, turn ends immediately. Never below 0 Grit.
